history.recommendation_text: The Board reiterates its previous recommendation that the Administration ensure all ICT budget proposals are reviewed on the basis of the same standard and method.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests the closure of the recommendation. The Office has implemented several measures to enhance the compliance, consistency and accuracy of ICT budget proposal submissions. This consistent approach has led to a significant improvement in compliance. A total of 90 per cent of regular budget entities and special political missions submitted their budget proposals to the Office for review, compared with 70 per cent in the previous cycles. In 2024, the Office was working on the 2026 budget submissions. The attachments provided as evidence were generated in 2024 but apply to 2026.
history.board_assessment: Given that the budget review conducted in 2024 for 2026 had a compliance rate of 90 per cent, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
